cost_lesson: A six-file tree cost about $2.70 and 6 minutes through the real harness. The default cap of $2 per fixture is too low and $8 per CardDemo run is probably too low. A full run of 13 fixtures and 3 CardDemo runs is likely to cost tens of dollars and to eat a large share of a usage window.
